newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangpakong Ind debuts at 14 baht/share.
newsitem.headline: Bangpakong Ind debuts at 14 baht/share.

text.p: Industrial project owner Bangpakong Industrial Park 2 Plc debuted on the Thai stock exchange at 14 baht per share, down four baht from its initial public offering price of 18 baht.
Bangpakong Industrial Park currently owns two industrial park areas in the southeastern provinces of Chonburi and Rayong.

"Bangpakong Industrial isn't expected to do well as the market is on a downward trend. Its projects concentrate heavily on Japanese investors and foreign investment still needs time before it picks up," said a broker.
The stock eased further to 13 baht per share by 0317 GMT.
